fieldNotes.siteIdentification: Confirmed the Layton Dairy as the central/west processing block on the shared 500 N Sugar St Kroger campus, distinct from the Smith's solar-roofed Distribution Center to the north (~41.066) and the grey-roofed bakery/cold-storage warehouse to the SW (~41.0628). The dairy is identified by its bulk milk/cream silo cluster and process-tank farm (round vertical tanks visible at z20 near 41.0642,-111.9831), heavy roof process piping, and the 'Smith's' red-logo office front on Sugar Street (Street View pano M7U59CyNhNNICpz2su66pA). Dairy Foods directory lists 'Kroger Layton Dairy' at this address.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled access from N Sugar Street (west) into a fenced campus. An internal staffed checkpoint booth sits mid-yard (~41.0651,-111.9853, z20) with yellow channelized lane striping funneling tractors single-file past it between the office/parking apron and the inner dock/tanker yard. Perimeter chain-link fencing runs the full Sugar Street frontage (Street View 2022-11).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small free-standing booth (~1-vehicle footprint) in the truck lane mid-yard with channelizing lane markings and a tractor stopped at it in z20 imagery; functions as the manned checkpoint for the inner yard.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved yard inside the checkpoint holds queued tractors and tankers before the dock/process bays.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long approach from Sugar Street across the parking apron plus deep internal yard easily holds 3+ trucks before the checkpoint and docks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Trucks enter and exit through the same west Sugar Street access and the single internal checkpoint.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved apron and yard width at the checkpoint with unused room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock/tanker bays on the south and east faces of the dairy process block plus a dedicated tanker/loadout courtyard; estimated ~22 doors total (band 10-25). Low-confidence exact count - much of the process loadout is canopy-covered tanker bays rather than standard dock doors.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked in the dairy's south/east yard rows and reefers staged along Sugar Street (Shaffer reefer observed curbside); 10-25 band for the dairy's own allocation within the much larger shared campus drop yards.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive trailer storage exists on the shared campus (hundreds of trailers in center/east lots); the dairy uses a portion for reefer/empty staging.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Part of a multi-building Kroger campus (Smith's DC + Layton Dairy + Layton Bakery / cold storage) sharing one fenced property and yard.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside Layton, UT urban/suburban industrial fabric with residential subdivisions directly abutting the south property line; classified Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No clear truck scale/weigh pad isolated for the dairy in available imagery; left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the dairy or campus buildings.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~21 acres for the dairy plant building plus its dedicated west office frontage and south/east operating yard; the full shared campus parcel is far larger.
